From: Elaine Torres <elaine@talentworks.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Offer proposal for Diego Ramirez (SDE2)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking Diego through the loop last week. Based on the hiring manager's guidance and comp banding, here's the packaged proposal for signoff before I pull the formal offer together: 

- Role: SDE2, Platform
- Base: $160,000
- Target annual bonus: 15% (OTB)
- Equity: 18 RSU grant vests over 4 years (25/25/25/25)
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (one-time) to help with relocation timing
- Relocation stipend: $5,000 (lump sum)
- Start date requested: 2028-08-01
- Cost center: ENG-PLAT-04, HC request HIRE-2028-321

Attached: candidate resume and a one-page offer_summary.xlsx I drafted. Compensation looks slightly above midpoint because of market and candidate counter. Please confirm whether this aligns with the SDE2 standard band and whether you want rewards/hiring to adjust equity vs signing.

Candidate: Diego Ramirez (diego.ramirez@gmail.com), currently at DataWave. He has two competing offers but preferred Redwood after the on-site. Recruiter asks to get the offer sent by EOD tomorrow if we have approvals.

Thanks,
Elaine Torres
TalentWorks Recruiting (external partner)

Attachments: ramirez_resume.pdf, offer_summary.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Elaine's proposed package for Diego. Quick notes:

- Base of $160k is within band but on the higher side for SDE2 in Bay Area — manager willing to justify based on impact.
- Equity proposed at 18 RSUs; I recommend we move to 20 RSUs to keep total comp competitive vs peers (candidate has strong infra background). That would still map to the SDE2 upper-quartile for our band.
- Signing bonus $10k + $5k relocation is fine, but can we confirm tax/recapture rules for the relocation stipend?
- Confirm proposed start 2028-08-01.

Please review and sign off (Marissa for comp / rewards, Karthik for hiring budget). If approved I'll instruct Elaine to send the formal offer and attach the manager approval note.

Rishi
Director, Talent Partnerships
Redwood Inference
